app.title: Coop TD Giant Farm Calculator
app.subtitle: Estimate time, stamina and rewards from farming Giant Invasion

inputs.cycleHint: One cycle = (runs per entry ticket − 1) ticket runs + 1 giant run.
inputs.showExpSilver: Show EXP and silver in reward tables
inputs.convertTicketsToGacha: Convert total draw tickets into equivalent resources (owner-measured draw rates)

results.staminaBudget: Daily stamina budget (regen + ads + default diamond buys)
results.gachaConverted: Draw tickets in totals are converted to equivalent resources from an owner-measured session ({{draws}} draws → {{parts}}). Per-run rows still show raw tickets.
results.diamondSpend: Diamond spend ({{days}} days × default purchases + extra)
results.basisRun: Each run: fixed {{stamina}} stamina at 1x (multipliers scale linearly); {{hard}} waves on Hard, {{other}} on Hell+
results.basisDaily: Daily stamina: 1 point per {{regenMin}} min regen = {{regen}}, ads +{{ads}}

footer.disclaimer: Clear rewards seeded from meowdb.com; giant kill rewards (base draw tickets + per-stage God Stones / Jelly / Royal Jelly + relics) from the official game announcement, range values taken as midpoints. In-game values are authoritative.
